text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you ready?!
Turbo's already all set!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It's a Carrot Hamburger Steak!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The cafeteria is all-you-can-eat, but the popular items run out!
So today! Turbo is gonna be the first in line to eat!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wondered what the commotion was so early in the morning... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the popular carrot hamburger steak
will be served at today's lunch buffet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Twin Turbo wants to be
the very first to go eat it, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...So we're having carrot hamburger steaks
today. The sweetness of the carrots and
the savory meat juices blending together..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, ehehehe.
Time to eat a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Today is carrot hamburg steak, then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I should eat plenty of white rice, too.
Everyone is always saying that
balance is important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There are far too many formidable rivals...!
choice_data_list: If we're going for number one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Finishing it might be possible, but taking first place could be tough.
Should we come up with a strategy?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo won't lose!! Turbo always wants to be number one, so Turbo's definitely gonna wiiin!!
choice_data_list: Shall we think of a strategy?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I have a strategy!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"When the chime rings, I run!!
I dash like dadadada-dash,
and then I storm off like dodododo-dash!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: And then, KA-BOOM! Followed by a massive BA-BAAAM! And then I'll be all like, "How do you like THAT?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm at a loss. I have no idea at all.
I suppose it means I should just push through on momentum as always."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up against formidable rivals of that caliber,
going in without a plan leaves no chance of victory.
However...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this for so loooong!
They're serving carrot Salisbury steak!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I lost last time, after all!
I was determined to win this time around!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Let's do this!!
This time, Turbo's gonna wiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is brimming with motivation.
In that case, she doesn't even need a strategy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What I can do for Twin Turbo as her trainer right now is to fire her up and give her a push forward—!
choice_data_list: Just believe in your own speed and you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
Oooooooh! Leave it to meee!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because Turbo is fast!!
I'm gonna run with a WHOOSH so fast that nobody can catch up!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: The Carrot Hamburger Steak belongs to Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At noon that day, cheers erupted from the cafeteria.
Because standing there was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A dead heat!! So frustrating!!
But we did our best, so that's fine!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week, Oguri Cap――
There stood Twin Turbo, right alongside those renowned big-eater horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! Turbo's always in the lead!
I won't lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo Engine full throttle, whooosh, zoom, zoooom!!
Watch me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That afternoon.
Inside the bustling cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was Twin Turbo,
having finished her carrot hamburger steak
with a look of complete satisfaction on her face.
